## Admissions Information

Admissions Calendar

The full range of courses offered by the University of Strasbourg will be published in mid-December 2026.

Applications for international students will be available on Etudes en France’s (EEF) platform, which will open on October 1, 2026. As a Lafayette Fellow applicant, you must apply through EEF by December 15, 2026.

Admissions Process [...] ## Eligible Programs for Lafayette Fellows

List of Programs

All Master’s programs offered by University of Strasbourg are eligible for the Lafayette Fellowship except for the formats which are not compatible with the constraints of the Fellowship (apprenticeships, Erasmus Mundus/programs abroad, DU, etc.). Please find the list of ineligible formats here.

All course offerings for 2027–28 will be available on the “Études en France” platform and the university’s website by October 1, 2026.
